    # Saving: d(d,i)+d(d,j)-d(i,j)
    savings = []
    for i in range(len(customers)):
        a = customers[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, len(customers)):
            b = customers[j]
            s = matrix[depot][a] + matrix[depot][b] - matrix[a][b]
            # Deterministic tie-break: larger saving, then smaller depot-to-a, then node ids
            savings.append((s, matrix[depot][a] + matrix[depot][b], a, b))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1], -x[2], -x[3]), reverse=True)

    def can_merge(ra, rb, la, lb):
        # ra: index of route containing la node at one end; rb similarly
        # Only merge end-to-start with orientation specified by la_is_end, lb_is_start
        return route_load(routes[ra]) + route_load(routes[rb]) <= capacity

    for item in savings:
        _, _, i, j = item
        if i not in pos_in_route or j not in pos_in_route:
            continue
        ra, ia = pos_in_route[i]
        rb, ib = pos_in_route[j]
        if ra == rb:
            continue

        r_a = routes[ra]
        r_b = routes[rb]
        # Identify ends
        i_is_start = (i == r_a[0])
        i_is_end = (i == r_a[-1])
        j_is_start = (j == r_b[0])
        j_is_end = (j == r_b[-1])

        # Merge cases:
        # 1) end(i) + start(j): reverse a not needed; b not needed
        # 2) start(i) + end(j): start(i) needs reversal of a; end(j) needs reversal of b; but easier: convert both
        merged = False

        if i_is_end and j_is_start:
            if route_load(r_a) + route_load(r_b) <= capacity:
                newr = r_a + r_b
                routes[ra] = newr
                routes[rb] = []
                # update positions for nodes in merged-out route
                for k, v in enumerate(newr):
                    pos_in_route[v] = (ra, k)
                merged = True
        elif i_is_start and j_is_end:
            if route_load(r_a) + route_load(r_b) <= capacity:
                newr = r_b + r_a  # i at start, j at end => reverse merge orientation implicitly
                routes[ra] = newr
                routes[rb] = []
                for k, v in enumerate(newr):
                    pos_in_route[v] = (ra, k)
                # Note: routes[rb] nodes updated via newr; pos_in_route already updated for all nodes in ra
                merged = True
        else:
            # Also allow end-to-start if one side can be reversed in-place deterministically
            # If i is start and j is start: reverse a then merge end-to-start with b start
            if i_is_start and j_is_start:
                if route_load(r_a) + route_load(r_b) <= capacity:
                    r_a_rev = list(reversed(r_a))
                    newr = r_a_rev + r_b
                    routes[ra] = newr
                    routes[rb] = []
                    for k, v in enumerate(newr):
                        pos_in_route[v] = (ra, k)
                    merged = True
            elif i_is_end and j_is_end:
                if route_load(r_a) + route_load(r_b) <= capacity:
                    r_b_rev = list(reversed(r_b))
                    newr = r_a + r_b_rev
                    routes[ra] = newr
                    routes[rb] = []
                    for k, v in enumerate(newr):
                        pos_in_route[v] = (ra, k)
                    merged = True

        if merged:
            # Optional early stop if we already reduced to hint vehicles
            if n_hint is not None:
                active = 0
                for r in routes:
                    if r:
                        active += 1
                if active <= max(1, int(n_hint)):
                    break

    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    # Intra-route 2-opt (deterministic first-improvement per route)
    def two_opt_improve(r):
        if len(r) < 4:
            return r
        best = r
        best_cost = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        # One pass with first improvement to keep deterministic and fast
        while improved:
            improved = False
            m = len(best)
            for i in range(m - 3):
                a = best[i]
                b = best[i + 1]
                for k in range(i + 2, m - 1):
                    c = best[k]
                    d = best[k + 1]
                    cur = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new < cur:
                        cand = best[:i + 1] + list(reversed(best[i + 1:k + 1])) + best[k + 1:]
                        cand_cost = best_cost - cur + new
                        if cand_cost + 1e-9 < best_cost:
                            best = cand
                            best_cost = cand_cost
                            improved = True
                            break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best

    routes = [two_opt_improve(r) for r in routes]

    # Inter-route relocate: move one customer to another route at best position if feasible
    # Deterministic best position by minimal resulting cost increase; try each node once (bounded)
    # Keep number of routes reasonable; avoid heavy O(n^3).
    def find_best_insert(route_from, route_to, node):
        # route_from: index of route containing node at some position
        # route_to: list
        load_to = route_load(route_to)
        if load_to + demands[node] > capacity:
            return None
        # compute best position in route_to
        best_pos = None
        best_delta = None
        m = len(route_to)
        # Remove node later, but delta uses edges around insertion position
        # Insertion after position p (between p and p+1), with p=-1 meaning before first, p=m-1 meaning after last
        for pos in range(-1, m):
            if pos == -1:
                # depot -> node -> first
                old = matrix[depot][route_to[0]] if m > 0 else matrix[depot][depot]
                new = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][route_to[0]] if m > 0 else matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                # if m==0, old should be 0 because route_to empty won't happen here (we avoid)
            elif pos == m - 1:
                # last -> node -> depot
                old = matrix[route_to[m - 1]][depot]
                new = matrix[route_to[m - 1]][node] + matrix[node][depot]
            else:
                u = route_to[pos]
                v = route_to[pos + 1]
                old = matrix[u][v]
                new = matrix[u][node] + matrix[node][v]
            delta = new - old
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and node < node):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = pos + 1
        return best_pos, best_delta

    # Create mapping node->(route_idx, pos)
    node_loc = {}
    for ri, r in enumerate(routes):
        for pi, v in enumerate(r):
            node_loc[v] = (ri, pi)

    # Try relocate from longer routes first (deterministic)
    route_order = sorted(range(len(routes)), key=lambda ri: (-len(routes[ri]), ri))
    moved_any = True
    iters = 0
    while moved_any and iters < 8:
        moved_any = False
        iters += 1
        for ri in route_order:
            r_from = routes[ri]
            if len(r_from) == 0:
                continue
            # For determinism: iterate nodes in route_from order
            for pi, node in enumerate(list(r_from)):
                # Attempt insert into the best other route by min delta, but only among top few routes
                best_target = None
                best_insert_pos = None
                best_total_delta = None
                load_from = route_load(r_from)
                # compute removal delta from r_from
                m = len(r_from)
                if m == 1:
                    # route becomes empty
                    rem_cost = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
                else:
                    prevv = depot if pi == 0 else r_from[pi - 1]
                    nextv = depot if pi == m - 1 else r_from[pi + 1]
                    rem_old = matrix[prevv][node] + matrix[node][nextv]
                    rem_new = matrix[prevv][nextv]
                    rem_cost = rem_new - rem_old  # delta removal from route_from cost
                for rj in range(len(routes)):
                    if rj == ri:
                        continue
                    r_to = routes[rj]
                    res = find_best_insert(ri, r_to, node)
                    if res is None:
                        continue
                    ins_pos, ins_delta = res
                    total_delta = rem_cost + ins_delta
                    # if same delta, prefer smaller rj then insertion pos
                    if best_total_delta is None or total_delta < best_total_delta or (
                        total_delta == best_total_delta and (rj < best_target or (rj == best_target and ins_pos < best_insert_pos))
                    ):
                        best_total_delta = total_delta
                        best_target = rj
                        best_insert_pos = ins_pos
                # Accept only improving moves
                if best_total_delta is not None and best_total_delta < -1e-9:
                    r_from = routes[ri]
                    node = r_from[pi]
                    # remove node
                    routes[ri] = r_from[:pi] + r_from[pi + 1:]
                    # update node_loc for nodes after pi in from
                    if routes[ri]:
                        for xpi in range(pi, len(routes[ri])):
                            node_loc[routes[ri][xpi]] = (ri, xpi)
                    # insert into target
                    r_to = routes[best_target]
                    routes[best_target] = r_to[:best_insert_pos] + [node] + r_to[best_insert_pos:]
                    # update node_loc around target
                    for xpi in range(best_insert_pos, len(routes[best_target])):
                        node_loc[routes[best_target][xpi]] = (best_target, xpi)
                    moved_any = True
                    break
            if moved_any:
                break
        # remove empty routes and refresh orders deterministically
        routes = [r for r in routes if r]
        node_loc = {}
        for ri, r in enumerate(routes):
            for pi, v in enumerate(r):
                node_loc[v] = (ri, pi)
        route_order = sorted(range(len(routes)), key=lambda ri: (-len(routes[ri]), ri))

    return routes
